purpose: Planning registry only; this is not a SemidenseConfig or an executable training configuration.

baseline.legacy_loading_policy: Retain the existing strict v1 loading and default H0 behavior. A v2 migration may only initialize an explicit allowlist of new parameters; mismatched legacy tensors must fail.

new_mechanisms: Expose the existing D16 target-coordinate and matchability predictions without executing the H0 fitter in Flow mode.
Add a bounded confidence-weighted Gaussian geometry reward before D8 global dual-softmax.
Add normalized absolute feature discrepancy and optional local DGFO residual adapters to QRRU.
implementation_scope.necessary_interface_adaptation: Construct the D2 4x4 target lattice directly from the predicted D8 parent correspondence in all no-H0 experiments.
preserved_structure: Global D8 cosine matching, FP32 dual-softmax and chunked execution
D2 16x16 local matching and confidence composition
QRRU 4x4 feature patch, 2x2 controls and recurrent update mechanism
out_of_scope: A separate D8 flow update network
D2 Flow Refinement or a new D2 geometry model
Replacing QRRU with unconstrained dense flow
Inference masks derived from ground truth
Training, full evaluation or claiming v2 accuracy before the corresponding stage is implemented and verified

data_policy.validation_role: Select flow prior hyperparameters, training mixture and update budget before locked evaluation.
data_policy.googleearth_val_directory_policy: Test_Data/GoogleEarth/val is locked evaluation data despite its directory name; it is different from MHINet_RGB_512/val and must not select hyperparameters.
data_policy.reproducibility: Register manifest hashes, geographic and parent-group isolation, initialization hash, seed, update budget, match caps and code commit before each run.
data_policy.manual_gcp_policy: Only completed and reviewed human annotations are eligible. Report GCP geometry evaluation separately from synthetic-H correspondence evaluation; offline fitted H never enters v2 inference.

matching.temperature_policy: Preserve learned D8/D2 temperatures from the fixed initialization; 0.05 is only the legacy constructor initialization.

flow_guidance.hyperparameter_status: Unvalidated initial values; tune only on MHINet_RGB_512/val.
flow_guidance.candidate_support: All D8 cells on both sides; invalid, out-of-bounds or unreliable Flow predictions contribute zero reward and do not reject the image pair.
flow_guidance.coordinate_contract: A-to-B, align_corners=False cell-center normalized coordinates. flow16_norm = flow16_target_norm - source_grid16. Interpolate displacement to D8, add source_grid8, and compute Gaussian distances in D8 pixels.

qrru.adapter_initialization: Zero-initialize both 1x1 residual adapters; retain legacy encoder tensor shapes and names.
qrru.control_interpolation: Reuse interpolate_controls with actual control positions +/-1 and feature offsets +/-1.5, including its polynomial extrapolation.
qrru.mask_policy: Use real source and warped-target sampling validity plus patch-neighborhood validity; mask invalid neighbors and define a finite fallback for an empty neighborhood. Do not use GT masks at inference.
qrru.first_iteration_dgfo: Zero initial controls imply zero propagated flow and zero DGFO residual; discrepancy remains an independent branch from the first iteration.

training_plan.optimizer_policy: Fresh optimizer and scheduler for v2; never resume the v1 optimizer across architecture changes.

flow_head_stage.interface_requirement: Separate locator prediction from H fitting and split geo/mat/cls losses from the H loss; setting h_weight=0 alone does not remove existing H-output dependencies.

training_input_mixture.eligibility: Use GT only to label geometrically valid predicted D2 inputs within a preregistered local correction range. Do not force severe parent mismatches to be repaired by a small patch.
training_input_mixture.selection_policy: Confirm mixture and correction range using training and validation data before locked evaluation.

qrru_stages.controlled_comparison: Independently initialize matched-training legacy C, D and E from the same legacy checkpoint; share data, cached C D2 inputs, seeds and optimizer update budgets. D adds discrepancy and E adds DGFO. Retain frozen C for the fixed-weight B-to-C prior comparison.

legacy_qrru_control.matched_arm_policy: Train the original QRRU without new branches on the identical mixture and budget used for D/E; compare this arm with D to isolate discrepancy.

qrru_stages.f_control: For the primary E-versus-F inference contrast, reuse the same E-trained weights and only disable the Flow prior. Any additional F training on B-generated D2 inputs is a separately registered equal-budget run.

training_plan.joint_training: Optional only after separate Flow and QRRU gains pass stage acceptance; define its own freeze policy and preregistered budget.

stages.scope: Freeze the current MHI v1 baseline and register the MHI v2 branch and implementation plan.
acceptance: mhi-v1 points to the recorded baseline commit.
The freeze manifest records the fixed checkpoint and evaluation references.
The v2 plan is explicitly non-executable and no training has started.

stages.scope: Expose D16 Flow0 target coordinates, displacement, matchability and validity while retaining legacy H0 mode.
acceptance: 512 and 784 shape contracts and A-to-B coordinate direction pass.
Zero displacement preserves identity including boundaries.
Flow mode does not execute the H fitter and supports independent EPE and valid-coverage measurement.
Legacy H0 checkpoint loading and inference remain available.

stages.scope: Implement the no-H0 Direct-D8 fine baseline and optional D8 Flow reward before dual-softmax; establish MHIv2-B then MHIv2-C.
acceptance: flow_prior=None retains the legacy matcher path; lambda=0 matches the no-H0 baseline.
Full and chunked paths agree for logits, mutual selections and dual-softmax confidence.
Direct-D8 forms exactly 16 child points per parent without H0.
No-H0 modes remove H validity and predicted-H overlap gates in both training and inference.
Invalid Flow falls back to appearance matching without NaNs or pair failure.
D8 timing and memory are measured independently before full evaluation.

stages.scope: Add discrepancy encoding and a zero-initialized residual adapter to legacy QRRU; evaluate MHIv2-D against MHIv2-C.
acceptance: Explicit v1-to-v2 weight migration allows only new branch parameters to be missing.
Before training, migrated QRRU reproduces legacy outputs within a declared numerical tolerance.
Existing 4x4 patches, 2x2 controls and four recurrent updates are preserved.
Gradients reach the discrepancy branch after the expected zero-adapter warm-up.

stages.scope: Add masked 3x3 local DGFO using discrepancy Q/K and interpolated control-flow values; evaluate MHIv2-E and MHIv2-F.
acceptance: Attention normalizes over valid neighbors with finite empty-neighborhood handling.
Zero adapters preserve the migrated legacy output at initialization.
The first iteration has zero DGFO flow residual as expected.
Later iterations provide finite gradients and logged propagation-residual magnitudes.
No invalid sampling, NaNs or unexplained large peak-memory increase is introduced.

stages.scope: Run separately supervised Flow and controlled QRRU training, then fixed-protocol A-F evaluation; consider joint fine-tuning only after independent gains.
acceptance: Validation selection and equal legacy-C/D/E QRRU update budgets are registered before locked evaluation.
All runs preserve fixed manifests, initialization provenance, output caps and stage-specific freeze policies.
Report stage-wise precision, EPE, QRRU improvement/degradation, timing and memory alongside final Pre@3.
Human GCP and synthetic-H evaluation remain separate.
Stop conditions are assessed before any optional joint-training expansion.

ablation_matrix.id_policy: Always use MHIv2-A through MHIv2-F in filenames and reports. original_proposal_id refers only to the supplied v2 proposal, never the historical H0-position A-D experiment.

experiments.purpose: No-H0 control for the Flow reward
Isolate DGFO under matched training conditions
Check QRRU gains without the Flow reward

primary_contrasts.comparison_arm: same frozen weights; toggle only Flow prior
matched_qrru_training for C and D; same input mixture and optimizer update budget

primary_contrasts.attribution: Complete architecture comparison; cannot assign gain to a single module
Flow prior dependence with the same trained E weights; inference toggle only

qrru: EPE before and after each iteration
repair and damage of initially correct points
DGFO residual and gradient by iteration
evaluation_plan.tolerance_and_threshold_policy: Numerical tolerances, Flow quality gates and material-regression thresholds must be registered from engineering requirements or training/validation evidence before locked evaluation.

legacy_pre_at_10.source: Frozen historical A match NPZs; use identical support, macro averaging and denominator rules as new variants.

stop_conditions: If Flow predictions are inaccurate and geometric rewards promote wrong candidates, stop increasing lambda and first improve independent Flow supervision.
If D8 improves but Direct-D8 fine matching loses too many correct candidates, stop attributing the issue to QRRU; any new D2 geometry model requires a separate experiment.
If DGFO has no repeatable Pre@3 benefit over discrepancy-only QRRU at matched budget, retain the simpler discrepancy model. Match-count growth alone is insufficient.
